## Intent

Dogfood: 4-gram redundancy flags image markdown, quoted liturgy, and house motifs that are not slop.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Redundancy ignores non-prose and intentional refrain
  As a Pilobolus editor
  I do not want image alts or quoted absolution treated as slop
  So I can spend HITL time on real voice problems

  Scenario: Image markdown
    Given a published article whose only repeated four-gram is in image markdown
    When I run limatus scan
    Then those image spans are not redundancy findings
```
